modifications: Fixed project configuration in tjpgdcnf.h, including JD_FASTDECODE=0 to match the factory byte-clipped IDCT; standard stdint.h on Windows in tjpgd.h. Additional baseline input validation rejects invalid quantization-table IDs, unsupported sample precision, inconsistent frame component lengths and oversubscribed Huffman trees. IDCT/color/output algorithms are unchanged. Additional header guards reject zero quantizers, non-exact DRI/SOS lengths, non-baseline scan parameters, duplicate frame component IDs and scan/frame ID mismatches. Arbitrary distinct component IDs are retained. A three-byte tail field records those IDs; existing JDEC member offsets and IDCT/color/output code are unchanged.
